questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: What muscle controls with position of the ankle joint at heel strike?

options.A: Eccentric contraction of the anterior tibialis
options.C: Concentric contraction of the anterior tibialis

questions.explanation: At heel strike tibialis anterior contracts eccentrically to lower the foot to the ground.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 459
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: In physiotherapy the class of laser used is:
questions.explanation: Class 3 lasers are used in physiotherapy.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: To test for possible anterior shoulder instability a physical therapist should move the humerus into:
questions.explanation: Anterior instability is tested with abduction and lateral rotation (apprehension test).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: A home stretching programme is most effective when the patient:

options.D: Understands the technique and is given written or illustrated instructions

questions.explanation: Check technique at follow-up.
questions.sourceBook: Kisner & Colby, Therapeutic Exercise: Foundations and Techniques; Dena Gardiner, Principles of Exercise Therapy; Tidy's Physiotherapy (chapter-level reference)
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Exercise Therapy

questions.question: Thomas test is done for identifying which deformity?
questions.explanation: The Thomas test identifies a fixed flexion deformity of the hip.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: A manual muscle test is conducted on the medial portion of the deltoid. The muscle is able to move through the full range of motion with gravity eliminated, but cannot function against gravity. The results of the manual muscle test should be recorded as:
questions.explanation: Full range gravity-eliminated is grade 2 (poor).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: A woman in her third trimester of pregnancy is referred to physical therapy with acute low back pain. During a postural examination the therapist identifies several significant findings. Which of the following postural findings is not commonly associated with pregnancy?

options.D: Protraction of the shoulder girdle Suspension

questions.explanation: Cervical lordosis increases, not decreases, in pregnancy.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: OBGY

questions.question: A ramp which begins at ground level and ends 18 inches above ground should be at least ________ feet long?
questions.explanation: For a 1:12 gradient an 18-inch rise needs an 18-foot ramp.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: On ECG paper the smallest square (1 mm) represents:
questions.explanation: At 25 mm/s each small square is 0.04 s.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: To calculate % TBSA (according to the rules of nines) left lower extremity is given weightage of:
questions.explanation: Each adult lower limb accounts for 18% of body surface area.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: The normal residual volume of air in lungs is
questions.explanation: Residual volume is about 1200 mL.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/Pg. 436
questions.subject: Physiology

questions.question: The mitral valve of the heart controls the:

options.A: The amount of the blood from left. Atrium to the left. Ventricle
options.B: The amount of the blood from left. Atrium to the right. Ventricle
options.C: The amount of the blood from left. Ventricle to the right. Ventricle
options.D: The amount of the blood to pulmonary artery

questions.explanation: The mitral valve controls flow from the left atrium to the left ventricle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition
